job_description:
Responsibilities: Call Adi Shop's existing and premium customers to build rapport and understand their needs. Secure repeat orders by guiding customers through suitable product options and current promotions. Clearly communicate product prices, offers, and new updates to keep customers informed. Recommend appropriate products based on customer preferences and usage requirements. Confirm and verify accurate order information including customer name, address, and mobile number. Record daily call activities and order details accurately in the designated sheet or software. Resolve routine customer questions and promptly escalate complex issues to senior staff when needed. Work proactively and diligently to meet assigned sales targets while maintaining a positive customer experience. Maintain a polite, clear, and patient phone manner to ensure professional and friendly interactions.
